name: ride-mates
description: Ride Mates - a full-stack ride sharing app (React + Express + MongoDB). Single deployment: Express serves the built client and the API.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --omit=dev --prefix server
